def map_stages(df):

        'Prospecting': 'Prospecting',
        'Qualification': 'Qualification',
        'Needs Analysis': 'Needs Analysis',
        'Proposal': 'Proposal',
        'Negotiation': 'Negotiation',
        'Closed Lost': 'Lost',
        'Closed - Won': 'Won'
    }
    
    # Map the stages to outcomes
    df["Outcome"] = [STAGE_OUTCOME.get(s, s) for s in df["Stage"]]
    
    return df
